## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#today`
- Inventory note: Status tile "Đã hủy" selected: the list shows its empty message.
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"} → {"click":"[data-crm=\"today-status\"][data-id=\"cancelled\"]"}; it must show `#crm-today-search`.

  </PageHeading>
  <Grid old="crm-reception-stats" cols="repeat(8, minmax(0px, 1fr))" gap="1px">

    <Text><Strong>"0"</Strong> "Đã đến"</Text>
    <Button variant="secondary">"31 Chưa đến"</Button>  // crm=today-status

    <Button variant="secondary">"0 Đã hủy"</Button>  // crm=today-status
    <Button variant="secondary">"0 Vắng hẹn"</Button>  // crm=today-status

Kit components used: Button×9, Field×3, PageHeading×1, Card×1, TableShell×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
